zh.title: 越南航空波音787慕尼黑起飛疑越界擦地 德國BFU調查中
zh.summary: 越南航空波音787客機於慕尼黑起飛疑超越跑道並擦地；德國BFU展開調查
body: 越南航空（Vietnam Airlines）一架波音（Boeing）787-9客機，於8月15日在德國慕尼黑機場（MUC）起飛過程中，疑似超越跑道末端後才離地升空，並在此期間發生機尾擦地事件。事發當時，該客機於當地時間13時57分從慕尼黑機場的26L跑道起飛，隨後於不久後降落於26R跑道。
針對這起跑道超越與機尾擦地事件，德國聯邦航空事故調查局（BFU）目前已正式展開調查。德國調查人員指出，現場工作人員在跑道末端發現了輪胎痕跡，初步研判該些痕跡可能來自於該架越南航空波音787-9客機。

en.title: Vietnam Airlines Boeing 787 Investigated for Munich Airport (MUC) Runway Overrun
en.summary: Vietnam Airlines Boeing 787-9 suffered a tail strike after a suspected Munich runway overrun; BFU investigating.
body: A Vietnam Airlines Boeing 787-9 passenger jet suffered a tail strike after it appeared to overrun the end of the runway at Munich Airport in Germany before getting airborne on August 15. The aircraft took off at 13:57 local time from runway 26L and landed on runway 26R a short time later.

The safety occurrence is currently under investigation by Germany's Federal Office for Air Accident Investigation (BFU). German air accident investigators confirmed that tire tracks had been discovered at the end of the runway, which may have been left by the aircraft during its departure.
